checks: Read deployment manifests and setup/source files.
Read Python distribution metadata with importlib.metadata without importing analysis packages.
Read two installed Node package.json files.
Bounded software-name directory search under /data/xuancheng at maximum depth 4; dataset/cache/Git paths excluded.
Check matlab/spm/spm12/cat12/octave command visibility on xuancheng SSH PATH.

Verified official documentation/tutorial entrypoints for the core structural pipeline and available Python/visualization ecosystem; reused previously reviewed official chapters with explicit review_depth.
excluded: No .env, credentials, private token files, license contents or other-user task details read.
No image preprocessing, segmentation, statistics, package installation, GPU repair or server mutation performed.
limitations: Deployment/smoke manifests are historical evidence, not fresh executable health checks.
Live package metadata confirms distribution presence/version, not successful imports or method correctness.
A not-found result applies only to the stated environments, PATH and bounded search.

Tutorial entrypoints were separately checked against official sources on 2026-10-15. entrypoint_verified means a named page or repository entry was checked; chapter_reviewed means only the named chapter/reference was inspected. This does not claim entire manuals were read or examples executed.
SCN, MSN and MIND refer to analysis methods; package installation alone does not implement their scientific contracts.
All inventory entries have documentation pointers. Review depths distinguish reopened entrypoints/sections from registered sources; this does not mean all tutorials were ingested or validated.
